Short, neatly cropped chestnut brown hair with a clean side parting. Sharp, almond-shaped hazel eyes with a disciplined expression. Appears in the early twenties with a mature, stoic face. A sturdy, athletic build. Wears a polished silver plate mail chestpiece over a deep crimson tunic and matching trousers. A silver-trimmed blue cape is fastened to the shoulders.
BODY COLOR: pale skin
